slug: 道骨仙锋谪世录第115章归一
content_zh:
一、天象异变·三教惊谶
大胤三百零七年，霜降次日，天穹突现「三才逆位」之象：
-青冥墟仙云倒卷如血，九只玄鹤口衔焦木坠于明心院泮水台，木上刻「棋落人劫」四字；
-幽冥墟魔气凝成黑莲，在伽蓝寺因果井中绽放，井水沸反盈天，映出「众生为子」的血色幻影；
-玄都山太虚台先天八卦炉轰然炸裂，六十四片卦象残片悬浮空中，拼出「天道棋盘现红尘」的预言。
儒门反应：
太学主沈墨卿立于泮水台，指尖抚过焦木上的刻痕，衣摆处「山海经」异兽刺绣随灵气波动隐隐发亮。
身后明心院首座楚轩行持「春秋笔」凌空疾书，笔落处金光凝成《大胤祯祥录》残卷：「当此之时，正人君子当执棋柄，定鼎乾……」话未毕，焦木突然爆燃，灰烬中飘出三枚青铜棋子——「士」「将」「卒」。
释家反应：
云林伽蓝钟声骤响，震落满山红叶。
不动宗首座元晦盘坐因果井边，第三只眼映出黑莲倒影，掌心「卍」字法印与莲心魔纹两相抗衡。
藏经阁阁主昙无谶合十叹道：「棋盘既现，佛魔皆入劫中。
此劫非杀劫，乃心劫也。
」言罢，袈裟下露出半枚刻有「沙门」二字的棋子，正是五十年前圆寂的上一任伽蓝主持留下的遗物。
道家反应：
玄都山玉虚宫宫主萧素雪轻抚冰心弦，七根冰蚕丝同时震颤，奏出裂石穿云的《太初引》。
琴弦上凝结的寒霜顺着琴身蔓延，在「太阴玉」上冻出棋盘纹路。
宫后密室中，掌门清虚子望着八卦炉中飞出的卦象残片，忽然剧烈咳嗽，掌心咳出的鲜血竟在青砖上洇成「弈」字：「三百年前那场……天人之弈，终究还是来了……」
二、红尘墟·棋盘现世
西南荒漠「归墟古泽」突现异象：

干涸百年的湖底涌起幽蓝泉水，水面倒映出一座悬浮的青石棋盘，每格皆刻古老符文。
棋盘四角各立一人形光影，分别持「仁」「定」「虚」「乱」四字旗，正是儒释道与魔道的象征。
更诡异的是，棋盘中央「楚河汉界」处，竟躺着一名浑身浴血的神秘女子，青丝间插着半支雕花木簪，裙摆绣着早已失传的「太昊氏族」图腾。
首批入局者：
1.儒门双杰：沈墨卿携楚轩行踏剑而来，楚轩行手中春秋笔直指棋盘，笔尖金芒与「仁」字旗共鸣，湖面上顿时浮现层层书浪，欲将棋盘「抄录」为儒家所有。
2.听潮阁三毒客：风九幽摇着金铃踏沙而至，十二只蛊虫化作黑雾笼罩棋盘，其中一只血色蛊虫竟能啃食符文，试图破阵。
其身旁站着两名怪人：「笑里刀」宋缺（旦角扮相，折扇藏毒针）、「铁算盘」周明（末角模样，袖中铜钱刻煞星）。
3.皇宫密卫：八名黑衣金刀客破空而来，刀面刻「大胤龙御」徽记，为首者摘下面罩，竟是当今皇帝最宠信的「影子都护」凌九霄，他掷出九枚龙须箭钉住棋盘四角，朗声道：「天子受命于天，此棋当归皇室！
冲突初起：
凌九霄话音未落，风九幽的金铃突然急响，十二只蛊虫同时扑向龙须箭。
沈墨卿剑指楚轩行：「春秋笔可书礼义，不可助纣为虐！
」楚轩行笔尖一顿，却见棋盘上「士」位棋子突然飞起，精准点中凌九霄眉心，后者闷哼一声倒飞而出，面具跌落——露出半张爬满魔纹的脸！
content_en:
1. Celestial changes and three religions’ prophecies
In the 307th year of the Yin Dynasty, on the day after the frost, a "three talents reversed" phenomenon suddenly appeared in the sky:
- The fairy clouds in Qingming Ruins rolled back like blood, and nine black cranes held burnt wood in their mouths and fell to the Panshui platform of Mingxinyuan. The four characters "Chess falls and human calamity" is engraved on the wood;
-The demonic energy of Netherworld Ruins condensed into a black lotus, which bloomed in the cause and effect well of Jialan Temple. The water in the well boiled and filled the sky, reflecting the bloody phantom of "all living beings are children";
-The Xiantian Bagua Furnace at the Taixu Platform in Xuandu Mountain exploded, and sixty-four hexagram fragments were suspended in the air, spelling out the prophecy that "the Heavenly Dao chessboard appears in the world of mortals".
Confucian reaction:
Shen Moqing, the master of the Imperial Academy, stood on the Panshui Terrace. His fingertips touched the carvings on the burnt wood. The embroidery of the "Book of Mountains and Seas" on the hem of his clothes glowed faintly with the fluctuation of spiritual energy.
Behind him, Chu Xuanxing, the leader of Mingxinyuan, held the "Spring and Autumn Brush" in the air and wrote rapidly. The golden light where the pen fell condensed into the fragment of "Da Yin Zhen Xiang Lu": "At this time, a gentleman should hold the chess handle and set the cauldron..." Before he finished speaking, the charred wood suddenly exploded, and three bronze chess pieces floated out from the ashes - "Shi", "General" and "Pawn".
Buddhist reaction:
Yunlin Jialan bell rang suddenly, shaking the red leaves all over the mountain.
Yuan Hui, the leader of the Fudo Sect, sits cross-legged beside the Well of Cause and Effect, with the reflection of the black lotus reflected in his third eye, and the "Swastika" seal on his palm competing with the magic pattern of the lotus heart.
Tan Wu Zhen, the master of the Sutra Pavilion, put his hands together and sighed: "Now that the chessboard appears, both Buddhas and demons are in trouble.
This calamity is not a calamity of killing, but a calamity of the heart.
After saying that, half a chess piece with the word "Sramana" engraved on it was revealed under the cassock. It was a relic left by the previous Jialan Master who passed away fifty years ago.
Taoist reaction:
Xiao Suxue, the master of Yuxu Palace in Xuandu Mountain, gently stroked Bing's heartstrings, and the seven ice silk threads trembled at the same time, playing "Taizhu Yin" that cracked the stone and penetrated the clouds.
The frost condensed on the strings spreads along the body of the instrument, forming checkerboard patterns on the "Taiyin Jade".
In the secret room behind the palace, the headmaster Qing Xuzi looked at the hexagram fragments flying out of the Bagua furnace. He suddenly coughed violently, and the blood he coughed up from his palms smeared into the word "chess" on the green bricks: "Three hundred years ago...the game between heaven and man has finally come..."
2. Hongchen Ruins·Chessboard Appears
A sudden strange phenomenon occurred in the southwest desert "Guixu Ancient Ze":
Blue spring water surged from the bottom of the lake that had been dry for hundreds of years, and the water surface reflected a suspended bluestone chessboard, with ancient runes engraved on each square.
There are figures of light and shadow standing on each corner of the chessboard, holding four-character flags of "benevolence", "ding", "empty" and "chaos" respectively, which are symbols of Confucianism, Buddhism, Taoism and magic.
What's even weirder is that in the center of the chessboard, at the "Chu River and Han Realm", lies a mysterious woman covered in blood. Half of a carved wooden hairpin is inserted between her black silk stockings, and her skirt is embroidered with the long-lost "Taihao Clan" totem.
The first batch of entrants:
1. Two Confucian heroes: Shen Moqing came with Chu Xuanxing on his sword. Chu Xuanxing pointed the Spring and Autumn Pen directly at the chessboard. The golden light on the tip of the pen resonated with the flag of "Ren". Layers of waves of books suddenly appeared on the lake, trying to "copy" the chessboard to Confucianism.
2. The Three Poison Guests of Tingchao Pavilion: Feng Jiuyou came on the sand with a golden bell. Twelve Gu insects turned into black mist and enveloped the chessboard. One of the blood-colored Gu insects was able to eat runes and try to break the formation.
Standing next to him were two weirdos: Song Que, the "Xiao Li Dao" (who looks like a male actor, with a folding fan hiding a poisonous needle), and Zhou Ming, the "Iron Abacus" (who looks like a horn, and has a copper coin engraved with an evil star on his sleeve).
3. Palace Secret Guards: Eight golden swordsmen in black came out of the air, with the emblem of "Dayin Longyu" engraved on the blades. The leader took off his mask, and it turned out to be Ling Jiuxiao, the most trusted "Shadow Protector" of the current emperor. He threw nine dragon whiskers arrows to nail the four corners of the chessboard, and said loudly: "The emperor has been ordered by the sky, this chess piece belongs to the royal family!"
The beginning of the conflict:
Before Ling Jiuxiao finished speaking, Feng Jiuyou's golden bell suddenly rang sharply, and twelve Gu worms pounced on the Dragon Beard Arrow at the same time.
Shen Moqing pointed his sword at Chu Xuanxing: "The Spring and Autumn Pen can write down etiquette and righteousness, but it cannot help the tyrants to do evil!
"Chu Xuanxing paused with his pen, then saw the "Scholar" chess piece on the chessboard suddenly fly up, and accurately hit Ling Jiuxiao's eyebrows. The latter flew backwards with a groan, and his mask fell down - revealing half of it covered with demons.Tattooed face!
